title: Reckoner header (v2)
description: A transparent bar over a merlot hero: wordmark at the left, and at the right a faintly tinted group of medium 14px links with small chevrons ending in a solid linen 'contact' button. Links tint tan on hover over half a second, and their menus fade in below. On phones it is a fixed merlot bar with a square tinted menu button that opens a full-height list of large links.
notes: sits on the primary surface: put it over a primary-coloured hero (reckoner-v2-hero)
fixed at the top on phones, absolute (scrolls away) from 1024px, as on the original
desktop menus open on hover or keyboard focus with CSS; the phone menu needs JavaScript
